tanim: One analog input channel: reads a voltage, such as an analog sensor output or a variable resistor.

One digital input line read by software: button, switch, end stop, interrupt or status line. A device that needs several input lines needs one per line. A matrix device (keypad, LED matrix) with R rows and C columns uses R + C lines in total, not R x C.
not_: GPIO matrisi pine hemen her çevre birimi sinyalini verir; paketteki her GPIO.

tanim: One digital output line switched by software: lamp, relay, transistor, enable or reset line. A device that needs several output lines needs one per line. A matrix device (keypad, LED matrix) with R rows and C columns uses R + C lines in total, not R x C.
not_: GPIO matrisi pine hemen her çevre birimi sinyalini verir; paketteki her GPIO.

tanim: General I2C bus (SDA, SCL). One bus serves several I2C devices with different addresses.
I2S digital audio input (BCLK, WS, DIN), from a digital microphone or ADC.
not_: I2S_OUT ve I2S_IN aynı I2S denetleyicisini paylaşır (adet I2S).

tanim: I2S digital audio output (BCLK, WS, DOUT), to a DAC or amplifier.
not_: I2S_OUT ve I2S_IN aynı I2S denetleyicisini paylaşır (adet I2S).

tanim: Low-power I2C bus (LP I2C), usable while the main system sleeps.
Low-power UART (LP UART), usable while the main system sleeps.
One PWM output channel: brightness, speed or position control, tone generation.
One RMT receive channel: infrared remote control receiver.
not_: Adım 10c (L-5): alma da aynı bölümde açıkça var (Independent transmission and reception).

tanim: One RMT transmit channel: addressable LED strip (WS2812, NeoPixel) data line or infrared transmitter.
not_: Adım 10c (L-5): RMT sinyalleri tabloda P2/P3 öncelikli GPIO'lara GPIO matrisiyle gider.

tanim: General SPI bus (SCLK, MOSI, MISO, CS) for one SPI device.
not_: SPI2 sinyalleri sabit pinlerine bakılmaksızın her GPIO'ya gider (Table 2-10/2-11 dipnot 2). SPI ×N: tek hat, ayrı CS (Adım 10c, L-1).

tanim: CAN bus controller (TWAI) with TX and RX, connected through a CAN transceiver.
Asynchronous serial port with TX and RX, for one serial device.
not_: UART1'in P1 pini yok, her GPIO'ya atanabilir (2.3.5). UART0 da GPIO matrisiyle her pine gider (Table 2-10 dipnot 2).

tanim: One input whose purpose is to wake the chip from deep sleep: any wake-up button, switch or sensor signal, also when the words 'deep sleep' are not used.
not_: Deep-sleep'te IO MUX çalışmaz; LP IO MUX pinleri (LP GPIO) kullanılır.
